reason: A web composer enhancement that provides persistent local input history, draft and caret restoration, reverse search, snippets, templates, and compaction-aware recall.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页编辑器提供浏览器本地输入历史、草稿恢复、反向搜索、片段与模板管理及压缩上下文提示。
summaries.en: Adds browser-local input history, draft restoration, reverse search, snippets, templates, and compaction-aware recall to the DeepSeek Harness web composer.

capabilities: Stores sent messages, snippets, templates, and usage statistics in browser-local storage
Adds configurable keyboard shortcuts and a reverse-search overlay to the web composer
Reads session and workspace values to populate template variables and scope history
Imports and exports templates through explicit user actions
